text:
tomas: Hey all, first day — stuck in Okta device trust on Windows WSL. After signing in it errors: 'Device not supported: WSL detected'. Also no 1Password invite received and accessing drive.redwood.ai says 'request access'. Who's the right contact for a quick workaround?

claire-it: welcome @tomas! We generally don't enroll WSL containers for device trust. Quick workaround: enroll your host Windows machine (Settings -> Accounts -> Access work or school) and use a supported browser on Windows rather than inside WSL. Do you have admin on the host?

sam: @claire-it +1. If you need immediate Drive access we can add a temporary allowlist for your account while you finish host enroll. Also I'll re-send the 1Password invite. Which Windows version are you on?

tomas: Windows 11 Pro, standard corp laptop, I can enroll the host. Was trying to avoid switching contexts because my dev setup is in WSL. 1Password invite hasn't shown up yet.

helpdesk-bot: Ticket created: IT-4890 — "Tomas: Okta WSL device trust + 1Password + Drive access". Assigned to claire-it. ETA 3 hours.

claire-it: Sent 1Password invite to tomas@redwood.ai just now. I also enabled a temporary Drive bypass for your account for 2 hours so you can grab onboarding docs. Try signing into Chrome on the host and re-run Okta enroll (should present the prompt to approve device trust).

sam: FYI if you want to keep dev flow in WSL, we recommend using a passkey on the host and then use 1Password SSH agent to forward keys into WSL for git. Docs: https://intra.redwood.ai/dev/onboard/wsl-passkey (internal).

tomas: Got the 1Password invite, installed it. Enrolled host device in Okta, approved the profile, and now Device Trust shows as Enrolled. Drive opened fine and I can access the onboarding folder. I also created a platform passkey in Chrome — will follow the SSH agent doc later.

claire-it: Great — I'll close the temporary allowlist and mark the ticket resolved in a bit. Reach out if anything else blocks your repo access.

tomas: Thanks everyone — super quick. I'll report back if I hit any WSL-specific issues while setting up the forwarded agent. :thumbsup:
